title: Brand Manager
description:
As a Brand Manager, you'll lead the marketing strategy and growth, taking ownership of integrated campaigns, innovation, digital growth and product launches within a fast-growing category. Working cross-functionally with sales, digital, innovation and agency partners, you'll drive brand performance and deliver commercially impactful marketing programmes across the UK and international markets.

Client Details

Our client is a dynamic consumer healthcare company in Berkshire with a growing portfolio of market-leading brands. Known for its innovative culture and strong focus on health, the business offers the opportunity to make a visible impact within a collaborative and fast-paced environment.

Description

Brand Strategy & Planning:

Developing and delivering the brand strategy and annual marketing plans,

ensuring all activity supports business objectives and maintains consistent brand positioning,

messaging and tone of voice.

Trade Marketing & Retail Activation:

Supporting the Commercial team with compelling trade presentations, category stories and

retailer sell-in materials. Using shopper and category insight to optimise distribution, visibility

and point-of-sale activity across key retail partners.

Integrated Campaign Management:

Leading the planning and delivery of integrated campaigns across paid, owned and earned

channels. Working with internal teams and external agencies to ensure activity is joined up,

efficient and commercially effective.

Consumer Engagement & DTC Growth:

Working closely with the Digital Lead to drive DTC growth through effective customer

journeys, stronger consumer engagement and high-performing content. Using data and insight

to identify winning content, optimise performance and improve conversion across digital

channels.

Innovation & Product Development:

Partnering with the Innovation team to identify opportunities for product extensions, new

formats and breakthrough innovation that support the long-term growth.

Product Launches:

Working with the Commercial and Innovation teams to develop and deliver impactful launch

plans across the UK and international markets. Build awareness, engagement and retailer

support through creative, commercially effective campaigns.

Budget Management:

Managing the annual brand budget, ensuring resources are allocated effectively across

channels and campaigns. Monitoring expenditure, evaluate return on investment and optimise

spend to achieve business objectives.

Performance Analysis & Optimisation:

Tracking brand performance using sales, market share, digital, brand health and retail metrics.

Turning insight into practical recommendations that improve campaign effectiveness and

business performance.

Consumer, Category & Competitor Insights:

Working closely with Category, Insights and Research teams to identify market trends,

evolving consumer needs and competitor activity. Use these insights to shape strategy, unlock

growth opportunities and maintain a strong market position.

Profile

A successful Brand Manager should have:
- A strong track record of delivering growth, preferably for consumer healthcare, medical device, OTC, wellness or personal care brands, including omnichannel campaigns that drive awareness, engagement and sales.
- Strong understanding of digital marketing, DTC growth and customer journey development. Experience working with digital specialists and using data to improve consumer acquisition, engagement and conversion.
- Comfortable using analytics tools to track performance (e.g., EPOS, Google Analytics, Nielsen, continuous brand tracking data) and can adjust tactics based on what the data shows to optimise results.
- Excellent written, verbal and presentation skills, with the ability to influence and align cross-functional teams, brief agencies clearly and build string internal and external relationships.
- An analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and draw actionable insights.
- A self-starter who is comfortable working at pace, taking ownership and balancing strategic thinking with practical delivery.
- Excellent attention to detail across planning, delivering and evaluation ensuring consistency in brand messaging, creative quality and regulatory compliance.
- Good understanding of medical device , healthcare and cosmetic regulations and evidence-based claims, with the ability to translate regulatory and scientific requirements into clear, compelling and compliant brand consumer communications.
- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field is preferred (or equivalent work experience).
- Professional marketing qualifications (e.g., CIM certification) are desirable.

Job Offer
- Competitive salary
- Permanent position based in Berkshire
- Additional benefits to be confirmed.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

If you require any adjustments or accommodations during the recruitment process, we'll work with you to ensure you can perform at your best.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Key responsibilities for Marketing Manager
- Develop and deliver the overall marketing strategy across both estate agency brands, supporting sales, lettings, property management and wider business objectives.

- Work closely with branch teams to identify local marketing opportunities and provide proactive marketing support to drive instructions and enquiries.

- Create and manage engaging social media content across multiple platforms, including graphics, copy, photography and video.
- Produce and edit video content for property marketing, social media, recruitment and wider brand campaigns.
- Write and edit compelling marketing copy including website content, blogs, property-related campaigns, newsletters, email communications, brochures and advertising.
- Oversee the creation of printed and digital marketing collateral, including brochures, leaflets, direct mail, posters, branch materials, presentations and advertising.
- Protect and develop the identity of both brands, ensuring consistency in tone of voice, visual presentation and customer experience.
- Coordinate property marketing initiatives and campaigns, working with branch teams to maximise exposure and generate buyer, seller, landlord and tenant engagement.
- Manage customer review activity and reputation marketing, helping teams maximise positive customer feedback and ensure the customer experience is reflected authentically across marketing channels.
- Support recruitment marketing and internal communications when required.
- Manage relationships with external suppliers, agencies, printers, photographers and other marketing partners.
- Monitor campaign performance, digital engagement and lead generation, using insight and data to continually improve marketing effectiveness.
- Manage marketing budgets and ensure activity delivers strong commercial value.
- Keep abreast of marketing trends, competitor activity, developments within the property sector and opportunities to strengthen both brands within their local markets.

About you

You will be an experienced marketing manager professional who is equally comfortable developing a campaign strategy, writing a piece of copy, creating a social post or briefing an external supplier.

You will ideally have:
- Significant experience in a broad marketing role, ideally at Marketing Manager or Senior Marketing Manager level.
- Experience managing multiple brands, locations or business areas would be advantageous.
- Strong digital marketing and social media experience.
- Excellent copywriting, proofreading and communication skills.
- Strong creative judgement and an eye for design and brand consistency.
- Experience creating marketing collateral using platforms such as Canva and/or Adobe Creative Suite.
- A good understanding of websites, email marketing, SEO and digital lead generation.
- Strong organisational and project-management skills, with the ability to manage numerous campaigns and priorities simultaneously.
- A proactive, commercially focused approach and the confidence to bring forward new ideas.
- An instinctive understanding of brand reputation and the importance of building genuine relationships with customers and local communities.
- The ability to work collaboratively with people at all levels of the business.
- An understanding of estate agency or the property sector would be beneficial, although not essential.

The role - Marketing Manager

This is a varied Marketing Manager position for someone who enjoys having real ownership of marketing rather than working within one narrow specialism.

The successful candidate will play a key role in shaping how both brands are presented and perceived - by our customers, prospective customers and the communities in which we operate.

Commercial performance will naturally be an important part of the role, with marketing helping to create valuation opportunities, win new instructions and support business growth. Equally important, however, is ensuring that both brands remain recognisable, trusted and connected locally, with marketing that reflects their individual personalities, their commitment to customer service and their longstanding place within their communities.

If you're interested in learning more about this exciting role, please apply here and send your cv for consideration.
